denominator_notes: ALL is the registered denominator; strata are reported without dropping failures.
NO_REFERENCE_WINDOW is a subset of MARGINAL and ALL, not an additional sample pool.
MARGINAL_WITH_REFERENCE_WINDOW is the disjoint remainder after removing NO_REFERENCE_WINDOW from MARGINAL.
BAL tolerances score the same600 physical episodes; 1200 score members are not1200 independent rollouts.
FURN windows, roles, and P1 conditions reuse the same200 instance graphs; pooled counts do not create independent tasks.
N>=50 is shown for CERT_FEASIBLE; a high rate on any smaller descriptive subset does not qualify a formal gate.
Wilson95 intervals describe each cell; they are not used to change any scientific threshold or select a window/tolerance.
limits: Prior raw audit reused the independent stdlib evaluator; it is not a second independent scoring implementation.
BAL reference windows were copy/ID bound by that audit, not independently reconstructed in this report.
FURN strata are the frozen manifest strata; no condition-dependent certificate is recalculated here.
Only R5 FURN P1_50/P1_150 and BAL P0 are covered, not the complete required perturbation grid.
This version cannot establish any R7 role/version gate; R7 must use its own complete evidence.
No recovery rate, native robot behavior, learned policy advantage, SFR, or data admission is established.

scope: Curated author-owned aggregate results only; no NC asset payload or teacher-private inputs. Reader PASS means evidence consistency, not method acceptance.
